title: Your Data Is Safe. Your Focus Stays on Care.
lead: Yawmy Care is built with security at its core, ensuring your data remains protected while you focus on delivering exceptional care every day.
imageAlt: A computer screen showing a green security shield with a padlock, surrounded by charts and security icons in a bright office.

items.title: Encrypted, always.
items.body: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is limited by role.

items.title: Backed up daily.
items.body: Automatic. Nothing to remember, nothing to configure.

items.title: Access by role
items.body: A teacher sees only her own rooms. An admin cannot read private teacher and parent conversations.

items.title: Kept only as long as needed
items.body: Incident reports for two years. Chat deleted automatically after six months.
